title: TERRIBLE QUALITY!!!

description: Nothing says “wow” quite like this striking mixed peony arrangement. This item may need to be re-shaped when removed from the secure box to allow it to reach its fullest size. Your arrangement will look beautiful for years to come; simply wipe clean with a soft dry cloth when needed.
